title: असुर और राक्षस एक नहीं
style: Painted-realism vector characters (remotion/src/kit/real.tsx, Ravi Varma look: shaded skin, five-finger hands, set jewels, zari silk) in lit 2.5D scenes; one camera through flat layers. NO subtitles, no text, no labels.

shots.title: Ravana
shots.pick: Firelit Lanka night; push in on the ten-headed Ravana, sword raised, heads turning.

shots.title: Hiranyakashipu
shots.pick: Golden palace; Hiranyakashipu rests the gada on his shoulder and looks up.

shots.title: Not the same
shots.pick: Both face each other across the frame; a gold crack splits the screen between them.

shots.title: Two identities
shots.pick: Palm-leaf scripture opens by a lamp; two painted medallions (asura king / rakshasa king) drift apart.

shots.title: Kashyapa + Diti
shots.pick: Two portrait medallions (sage Kashyapa, Diti) send a golden thread down to Hiranyakashipu.

shots.title: And Ravana?
shots.pick: Pan right: Ravana's medallion lights up, he turns his head.

shots.title: Vishrava + Kaikesi
shots.pick: Sage Vishrava's medallion glows gold, Kaikesi's glows red-dark; the thread to Ravana turns red.

shots.title: War for heaven
shots.pick: On clouds before golden Amaravati, Hiranyakashipu's asura host charges the devas; lightning.

shots.title: Something interesting
shots.pick: Silence: a single lamp flame; a tied bundle of palm-leaf Rig Veda manuscript.

shots.title: Asura was not bad
shots.pick: An old rishi unties the bundle and reads; the leaf glows warm gold.

shots.title: Mitra and Varuna
shots.pick: Mitra (golden, sunrise) and Varuna (blue, ocean) stand side by side; gold halo on 'deva', deep-blue aura on 'asura' — both at once.

shots.title: The verse
shots.pick: Rishis chant around a dawn fire; rings of light rise toward the two kings in the sky.

shots.title: The verse 2
shots.pick: Mitra and Varuna bless from the sky, sun rising over the sea.

shots.title: Rakshasas differ
shots.pick: Night forest; red eyes open in the dark.

shots.title: Breaking the yajna
shots.pick: Rishis at a night yajna; a rakshasa looms out of the dark and stamps; the fire gutters, rishis recoil.

shots.title: Agni Rakshoha
shots.pick: Agni rises from the fire, palms out; a wall of flame drives the rakshasa back into the night.

shots.title: Ravana in Lanka
shots.pick: Ravana in golden Lanka at night, smiling.

shots.title: Maya and war
shots.pick: Shimmer: a rakshasa melts into a golden deer; then Ravana's ten heads roar, sword high, battle fire.
